acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: ### B5. Core refusal envelope is not uniform and two frozen Core modes break CCF-V1-004 - Severity: medium. Core: yes. Votes: 2/2 confirmed (the second verifier narrowed it). Reported by: wire-contract; related confirmed items from git-integrity (uncoded unborn HEAD / promisor errors, `internal/contextindex/git.go:253`) and go-runtime:cmd (false "not a Git repository" message from a subdirectory, `cmd/corvint/main.go:642`). - Locations: `cmd/corvint/local_completion.go:187` (`error` is an object `{code,message}`, no top-level `code`), frontier-error/0 (`{code, profile}`, no `ok`/`error`), `cmd/corvint/main.go:1347` (codeless branch), `cmd/corvint/core_freeze_test.go:177-211` (five cases only), `docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md:84`. - Failure: one condition (not a repository) yields five shapes across Core verbs; `dogfood status` and `frontier --json` are listed as Core modes yet do not match the CCF-V1-004 envelope. After rc.1 each fix is breaking under CCF-V1-004's own text. - Fix: before rc.1, either route `dogfood` and a Core projection of frontier-error/0 through `emitError`, or name the exemptions explicitly in CCF-V1-004; classify "not a repository" identically in all verbs; extend `TestCoreRefusalsKeepTheFrozenEnvelope` to one refusal per Core verb. Fold in: classify unborn HEAD and promisor-missing objects with codes and `supported_fixes` (as `affected` already does), and make the subdirectory refusal say "not the repository root; top level is X". - Known ticket: V1-0007 claims a unified envelope; none for the specific gaps.

completion.reason: Verified at 2ae988a3: Core refusals are classified alike, the CCF-V1-004 exemptions are named, and promisor-only objects are refused without fetching; focused tests pass. Completion follows owner acceptance of the B5 and V1-0284 CCF-V1-004 amendments.
